updates.title: Fix: the first block of a page is now parsed as markdown instead of being kept as HTML when `markdown.allowHtml` is enabled.
Fix: pages that were skipped as unchanged no longer disappear from the site navigation.

New `partials` setting to reuse markdown snippets on your pages. Include them where you need them with `<include file="..." />`, or let Doctor add them to every page with `partials.header` and `partials.footer`.
New `markdown.extended` setting to render emoji shortcodes, highlighted text, footnotes, definition lists and task lists. Enabled by default, and requires `markdown.allowHtml`.
